title: AZ-900 · Describe Azure storage services · Module assessment

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure storage account?

options.text: GZRS with read access to the secondary-region copy before failover
An Azure Migrate capability for inventorying workloads and evaluating migration readiness
A resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints

questions.explanation: Azure storage account is a resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints.

questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Standard general-purpose v2 refer to?

A NoSQL service for large amounts of structured, non-relational data

questions.explanation: Standard general-purpose v2 is the recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios.

questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Standard general-purpose v2: a name of 3–24 characters using lowercase letters and numbers only.
Azure storage account: a premium account type for Azure Files that supports SMB and NFS shares.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.question: Choose the TWO accurate statements.

options.text: Storage account naming rule: GZRS with read access to the secondary-region copy before failover.
Locally redundant storage (LRS): ZRS in the primary region plus asynchronous replication to LRS in a secondary region.
Zone-redundant storage (ZRS): synchronous replication across three availability zones in the primary region.
Zone-redundant storage (ZRS): the point in time to which data can be recovered, reflecting possible lag in asynchronous replication.
Locally redundant storage (LRS): replication of data three times within a single datacenter in the primary region.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Locally redundant storage (LRS) — replication of data three times within a single datacenter in the primary region; and Zone-redundant storage (ZRS) — synchronous replication across three availability zones in the primary region.
